source.fileName: IIT Gandhinagar - Optical Tables with Vibration Isolation Systems.pdf

scope.task: Prepare a source-grounded technical response matrix, retaining supplier service and documentation obligations.
scope.statement: First-pass annotation of the full visible content of physical PDF page 22 only. This does not establish whole-tender coverage; pages 1-21 and 23-42 are outside this annotation. Page 22 continues a larger annexure and is repeated in part by Annexure-II on later pages, which is not evaluated here.

review.method: Assistant-first-pass using Poppler selectable-text extraction and a 130-DPI rendered page image; quoted wording checked against both representations. No production PDF.js source-element IDs, offsets, or cell geometry were assigned.
review.adjudicationNotes: No second reviewer has checked these labels. Potentially ambiguous scope in the cost-recovery sentence and the grouping of service-response statements are flagged below; they are not adjudicated.

labels.interpretation: Provide general and specific training on equipment operation and application at IIT Gandhinagar, either at installation or within one week after installation.

atomicity.rationale: Training can be answered independently; the source gives alternative timing for the same deliverable.

conditions: At installation or within one week from the date of installation.

labels.interpretation: Provide online or offline service assistance within 48 hours; the source attributes this to the Manufacturer Authorization.

atomicity.rationale: A separately answerable support-availability commitment in its own bullet.

uncertainty: The source's actor phrase 'by the Manufacturer Authorization' is preserved but its intended relationship is unclear.

labels.interpretation: For instrument breakdown or malfunction, the vendor provides a service response within 48 hours after the reporting time.

atomicity.rationale: A separate breakdown-triggered response commitment in its own bullet; keep distinct from general assistance pending adjudication.

conditions: Clock starts at the reporting time.
uncertainty: Possible operational overlap with the preceding service-assistance bullet; no merger is assumed.

labels.interpretation: Extend the warranty when the system is down for more than two weeks because a service person or spares are unavailable.

atomicity.rationale: A distinct conditional remedy can be assessed separately from the warranty term and repair obligations.

conditions: System down due to unavailability of service person or spares.

labels.interpretation: Provide a three-year warranty, including third-party supplies if any, against manufacturing defects, starting from successful installation.

atomicity.rationale: Term, covered supplies, defect scope, and start date form one warranty commitment answered as a unit.

labels.interpretation: Rectify defects during the guarantee/warranty period free of charge, arranging free replacement wherever necessary.

atomicity.rationale: One remedial commitment with replacement as the stated alternative when necessary.

conditions: Defect occurs during the guarantee/warranty period.

labels.interpretation: The supplier or its agent bears the listed associated costs for both directions; the final applicability qualifier has unclear scope.

atomicity.rationale: Cost allocation can be answered separately from the repair remedy, while remaining linked to it.

modality: No cost will be borne by IIT Gandhinagar
conditions: Associated costs include item, insurance, freight, customs duty, and local taxes if any.
uncertainty: Placement of '(If applicable)' and its scope are unclear; retain source wording for adjudication.

labels.interpretation: Include the technical compliance report prescribed in Annexure-II with the quote.

atomicity.rationale: A separately verifiable tender-response document deliverable.

conditions: Report format/content is prescribed in Annexure-II.

atomicity.rationale: Document identity text, not an obligation.

limitations: This is a single-assistant provisional development annotation, not independent human adjudication or gold data.
Only physical page 22 was reviewed; this does not establish whole-tender or cross-page completeness.
The exact quotations were visually checked and whitespace-normalized against Poppler text; page-level/table-row location is approximate, with no production parser IDs, offsets, or bounding boxes.
The wording about Manufacturer Authorization, overlap between service bullets, and '(If applicable)' cost scope remains unresolved.
A repeated compliance report appears in Annexure-II on later pages; duplicate handling and whole-document source relationships were not reviewed.
